verdict.rationale: Safe schema changes are a fair question for a database like ClickHouse, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of online/non-blocking DDL, deploy requests, or branch-and-merge schema workflows. The closest items, local development via clickhousectl and 'push your local ClickHouse development to cloud', are adjacent tooling and do not document safe production schema migration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship schema changes safely — online DDL, deploy requests, or branch-and-merge workflows — without locking or breaking production
